description: Reference whitelist per project (blueprint §4.2 and §4.4, mechanism 1). The ClicaloVerifyReferences target in Directory.Build.targets compares every ProjectReference, PackageReference, GlobalPackageReference, FrameworkReference and assembly Reference declared by a repository file with this list and fails the build with CLCA001 before compiling. Only references declared in repository files are checked: transitive and SDK-implicit references follow from them. Change this file only with a justification (docs/architecture/enforcement.md).

analyzerProjects.description: Roslyn components referenced with OutputItemType="Analyzer" and ReferenceOutputAssembly="false". They run inside the compiler and add no runtime dependency, so any project may use them that way. Referencing their assembly requires a normal entry.

globalPackages.description: Packages declared once as GlobalPackageReference in Directory.Packages.props: analyzers applied to every project.

Clicalo.Domain.rule: Pure domain: model, invariants, commands and EngineReducer. BCL only (System.Collections.Immutable and Frozen included); never System.IO, System.Net or Microsoft.Win32 (blueprint §4.2).

Clicalo.Application.rule: Use cases, ports, stores, EngineHost and ForegroundOrchestrator. Depends on Domain and the logging abstractions only; never on Presentation, UI, Platform, Infrastructure or WPF (blueprint §4.2).

Clicalo.Presentation.rule: ViewModels without WPF, so the UI framework stays replaceable (ADR-0001). Depends on Application, Domain and CommunityToolkit.Mvvm; never on System.Windows*, Platform or Infrastructure (blueprint §4.2).

Clicalo.UI.Wpf.rule: The only WPF-aware layer: views, automation peers, windowing, pointer input and theming. Depends on Presentation, Application (UI port types only), Domain, WPF and CsWin32 (Windowing/ and Pointer/ only); never on Platform.Windows or Infrastructure (blueprint §4.2).

Clicalo.Platform.Core.rule: AOT-safe core shared with Sentinel and Launcher (KeyLedger, InjectionGate, LowLevelInjector, IPC contracts, Trust). BCL and CsWin32 only (blueprint §4.2).

Clicalo.Platform.Windows.rule: Win32 and WinRT adapters implementing Application ports. Depends on Application (ports), Domain, Platform.Core and CsWin32; WinRT projections come from the Windows TFM. Never on Presentation, UI, Infrastructure or WPF (blueprint §4.2).

Clicalo.Infrastructure.rule: Persistence, backups, catalogs, AI, updates and logging. Depends on Application (ports), Domain, Platform.Core (Trust only), Serilog, Velopack, Microsoft.Extensions.AI with HTTP resilience, and DPAPI; never on Presentation, UI, Platform.Windows or WPF (blueprint §4.2, §2).

Clicalo.App.rule: Composition root: Program, DI and lifecycle. May depend on every product project; nothing references it (blueprint §4.2).

Clicalo.Sentinel.rule: Native AOT guardian that releases the keys recorded in the ledger (ADR-0004). Platform.Core only (blueprint §4.2).

Clicalo.Launcher.rule: Native AOT system component launcher (ADR-0009). Platform.Core only, and only its Trust module (blueprint §4.2).

Clicalo.Generators.rule: Source generators run inside the compiler: netstandard2.0 and the Roslyn API only. Clicalo.Design.Math is source-linked, not referenced.

Clicalo.Analyzers.rule: Product-rule analyzers (CLC*) run inside the compiler: netstandard2.0 and the Roslyn API only.

Clicalo.Design.Math.rule: OKLCH, gamut mapping and WCAG contrast: pure math, no dependencies.

Clicalo.TestKit.rule: Shared test helpers (fakes, fixtures, snapshots). Referenced by test projects only.

Clicalo.Application.Tests.rule: Tests the Application layer with fake ports (blueprint §10.1).

Clicalo.Data.Tests.rule: Validates data/ against its schemas, i18n parity and token contrast (blueprint §10.1).

Clicalo.Generators.Tests.rule: Snapshot tests for source generators and analyzers.

Clicalo.Architecture.Tests.rule: Architecture rules over every product assembly (blueprint §4.4): the only test project allowed to reference Clicalo.App.

Clicalo.DevCli.rule: Developer utilities behind cl (i18n-check, trace, notes...). No product dependency.

InputProbe.rule: Instrumented raw Win32 window (no WPF) used as the physical truth of integration tests.
